name: 1338-manystreamdecode-1b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Dense Llama decoder (LlamaForCausalLM), 22 layers, 32 query heads over 4 KV heads, head_dim 64, hidden 2048, intermediate 5632, SwiGLU, RoPE theta 10000, vocab 32000, 2048-token context, bf16; ~1.1B parameters, ~2.2 GB of weights, ungated single-shard safetensors.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 2560 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. streams=256 is this era's own max_num_seqs default and is part of the declaration, not a starting guess; the KV cache does not bind anywhere near it.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, `request_format: plain`, fixed at 128 prompt tokens and 256 output tokens (min = max = mean on both); greedy (temperature 0.0) with ignore_eos and an empty stop list, so every request runs the same 255 generation steps over the same token count.
purpose: A compact 1B chat assistant streaming short replies to 256 concurrent users on a single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.2.0-era EngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, and there is
# no `--config` file loader in this era's CLI. Do not add keys from a later vLLM (no chunked
# prefill, no prefix caching, no `enforce_eager`, no `max_seq_len_to_capture`).

model: TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
